weekly_submissions.challenger_comments: so this is day 1, i am in Utah for work this week so have access to gym and great food options in the office. travelling back on Thursday this week so Jet Lag sleep etc will make it a fun week will ensure to try and get steps and eat calerories/ protein tagets,

Hi Chris so checkin for this first week. 

so i have been in Salt Lake City Utah working this week (writimg this from the aeroplane somewhere near Ireland on way to Heathrow. I have had access to office Gym and Office canteen which are both excellent and then stuck with some healthier evening meals from the local supermarket - precooked chicken and rice. i managed strength 3 days and a 10km run. 

I have been travelling overnight so will get my stpes for Friday and eat sensibily (i did have a 2 glass of wine on plane as its a long journey) will now be heathrow for a few hours so will get showered in lounge and then get out for a walk around the airport and try ang get my steps - currently at 100 😉 joys of sitting on a plane. 

Weekend will just be catching up on sleep and family and will get steps done and probably a run, will see about getting to gym for some strength. onto classes next week and into a more normal rythm. But i have hit all my win the days for the first 4 days. 

you will see my start weight was higher than i had shared for the data 88.6 i did not have access to the scales which i found at work when i sent you so i gave you what i thought i was. i have been sticking to around 2000 cals a day as i prefer round numbers.
